item: The urllib3 log filter is default-deny over a table read from the installed library, the library is bounded and registered, and scripts/guards_for_diff.py picks the checks to run before a first push
key_paths: src/ingest/urllib3_log.py; tests/test_urllib3_log_withholds_the_path.py; pyproject.toml; requirements.lock; configs/external_artifacts.yml; docs/maintenance/EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCIES.md; tests/test_external_freshness.py; scripts/guards_for_diff.py; tests/test_guards_for_diff.py; docs/maintenance/PRE_PUSH_GUARDS.md; docs/SECURITY.md; docs/ledger/OPEN_QUEUE.md
summary: The filter that keeps the request path out of the HTTP library's own log lines knew four loggers and the shapes of one release (a known shape was rewritten, anything else passed). It now carries a table of every log call urllib3 makes on its nine loggers, read from 2.7.0 and 2.8.0 (identical templates and arguments): a record that matches an entry has its target arguments rewritten, and a record that matches NO entry has its message withheld whole (logger, level and exception class name kept; arguments and traceback gone; never dropped). A test reads the INSTALLED library's source by AST and fails by name on a new, changed or removed log call, an argument the table does not name, or a logger the module does not cover; pyproject bounds urllib3 to >=2.7.0,<2.9 (the ceiling is the first release not read) and the registry entry urllib3-log-shapes records floor, verified release and ceiling with an upstream check, so an upgrade is a decision with a checklist. Not covered, said so: a child logger under those names, and the traceback of a known shape (the header-parsing warning logs the server's header text). Also scripts/guards_for_diff.py: before a first push it picks the tests main added since the branch left it (found by the merges into the branch), the tests the branch changed (untracked included), the test files that walk the tree, the blocking ruff lane and the style ratchet with its ceiling READ from ci.yml, and says when the base is ahead of the branch; the selection is tested on a throwaway git repository (21 mutants, 20 killed, 1 equivalent to the existence check). Why: CI found tests/test_sink_sweep_records.py, which main had added and the previous push had not run, and a CI cycle is about fifty-five minutes.
